title: Black
body: You do not remember the interval. You remember a ledger. You remember three discrepancies and a polite request to reconcile them. You remember saying yes, because there was no other form.

choices.label: Wake at shift start. Write it down.

outcome.text: The morning memo thanks staff for a quiet, incident-free week. Nobody remembers the fire. You do. In your pocket: the NULL KEY. Day 1 (again). There is no Building 7.
